facts.fact: The Digital Policy Alert and Tech Hive Advisory roundup of 2025 states that Algeria completed amendments to its data protection law in 2025, adding data protection officer appointment duties and stricter breach notification timelines; it gives no month, so the year is used.

The roundup states that Algeria released a compliance package of guidelines and four templates in 2025 to support implementation of the Data Protection Law, and records no decision or sanction for Algeria.
